itens.titulo: Parliamentary Secretary Naqvi highlights new action plan to protect workers from tariffs and strengthen Ontario industries
itens.resumo: Canada and Ontario have world-class automotive and steel industries and vast deposits of critical minerals. It has the workers, expertise, and resources to drive Canada’s economic transformation. By working together, the federal and provincial governments are protecting good jobs, attracting investment, and ensuring Ontario’s industries remain competitive.

Ao trabalharem em conjunto, os governos federal e provincial estão protegendo bons empregos, atraindo investimentos e garantindo que as indústrias de Ontário permaneçam competitivas.
